messages:
maya: Canary deploy finished for inference-api v2.3.1 — 10% traffic routed to canary. Running quick smoke plan: health endpoint, sample prompts, p95 latency, error rate. @raj @oliver can you run checks? Will hold at 10% for 20m before moving to 50% if green.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for inference-api v2.3.1 -> canary=10% | CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploys/3187654321
raj: On it, running 200 sample requests + health checks. Will post summary in ~5m.
oliver: I'll watch dashboards and traces for 30m. Paging thresholds set locally to p95 > 200ms or error_rate > 0.5%.
maya: Quick smoke commands I'm using (for anyone running manually):
```bash
# health
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.run/health || echo HEALTH_FAIL
# simple generation spot-checks
for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"summarize: The quick brown fox"}' https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate | jq -r '.choices[0].text' ; done
```
raj: Results from 200 requests: p50=46ms, p95=118ms, p99=210ms, errors=0/200. Sample outputs look consistent with baseline, prefix/KV cache warmed quickly. :white_check_mark:
oliver: Saw a small p99 tail localized to shard-4 (a handful of cold starts). Traces show slightly higher scheduling latency on that node. Not systemic. I'll open a short ops note and nudge autoscaler pre-warm for shard-4. No rollback yet.
sre_oncall: Monitoring: duplicated canary rules into canary namespace — alert if error_rate > 0.5% for 3m or p95 > 250ms. I'll take the page if it fires.
raj: One small thing: one prompt template returned truncated token occasionally on the "summarize:" test (~2/200). Re-running a focused set now to verify. Might be a normal edge-case.
devops: Hotpatch: fixed prompt-normalizer env var (typo) and deployed to canary in ~3m. Early checks show truncation gone on re-runs. Rolling update was quick, no restarts for healthy pods.
maya: Plan: hold at 10% for another 15m, then roll to 50% if metrics stay steady. Rollback plan: if any alert or significant regression, rollback to v2.3.0 and notify infra-oncall. Thanks everyone — ping here with any anomalies.
